title: Design Netflix Video Streaming
description: Model videos, users, watchlists, streaming sessions, and DRM.

data.text: Design a video streaming platform like Netflix. Users browse a catalog, add to watchlist, stream videos, and resume from where they left off.

data.title: Video, User, and WatchProgress
Why CDN for video?
data.text: Videos are large and latency-sensitive. A CDN caches video chunks at edge locations near users, reducing buffering and origin load.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Video is the catalog entity with stream URL
WatchProgress tracks resume position per user-video pair
StreamingService combines video lookup and progress
CDN is non-negotiable for video latency
data.takeaway: Video streaming is a CDN and state-tracking problem. Videos live on CDN. Progress lives in a fast store like Redis. The service just glues them together.
